translations.web: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.
translations.bsb: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.
translations.kjv: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.
translations.asv: For the word of Jehovah is right; And all his work is done in faithfulness.
